headline: JPMorgan Warns Lenders Demanding Cash-Flow Proof From AI Firms
summary: JPMorgan Chase noted that insurance costs against debt default for several AI-focused companies have reached record levels. The bank stated that lenders are demanding clear evidence of income generation and debt coverage beyond AI branding.
why: JPMorgan Chase is the largest bank in the United States and a leading global underwriter of corporate debt.

impacts.name: Technology
impacts.why: Tighter debt financing terms increase capital costs for cash-burning artificial intelligence start-ups.
